title: QMS Platform: Quantum Measurement Observability and Reconstruction Assurance
description: Paper-linked research software release of QMS, a quantum measurement observability and reconstruction-assurance framework with initial validation on two-qubit photonic tomography. Demonstrated capabilities include raw-count normalization, state reconstruction, physicality diagnostics, maximum-likelihood estimation, controlled degradation, measurement-context criticality, state-conditioned null-space observability, random-state validation, and noisy pseudoinverse error decomposition. Broader detector-family and real experimental validation are ongoing.
